breakdown.description: Laminar boundary-layer correlation is applied at a Reynolds number where the boundary layer would be turbulent/transition.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It repeated the user's incorrect instruction to use the laminar boundary-layer correlation (δ = 5 * x / sqrt(Re_x)). The ground truth correctly identifies that the Reynolds number would indicate a turbulent flow and specifies using a turbulent correlation instead. The Agent did not make this critical correction.
